text.en:
Constitution
Coordinating
There is hereby constituted
an Economic Coordinating
Council (hereinafter
referred to as ECC), composed of the President as Chairman,
Secretary of
Finance as Vice-Chairman,
and the following members: Executive Secretary.
Secretaries of Trade and Industry,
Budget and Management, Agriculture,
Director General of the National Economic and Development Authority,
Chairman of the Housing and Urban Development Coordinating Council.

Governor of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas
(BSP) shall be an ex-officio
member of the ECC, which membership is not inconsistent
with the BSP's
independence, as provided for in the Constitution to allow for economic policy
coordination.
Other concerned heads of agencies may be invited to participate
in the ECC's activities as needed.

Functions.
The ECC shall have the following functions:
Ensure the consistency and complementation
of all issuances,
pronouncements,
plans, programs and projects, and proposed
l~gislation with the country's economic reform direction to further
deregulation,
liberalization,
competition and increased private sector participation;

Secretariat.
A secretariat is hereby establ,ished which shall

Funding.
To carry-out
the provisions

amount of Five Million Pesos (P5 million)
shall be allotted as initial funding,
